mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tax_document (id, transaction_id, document_kind, document_scope_key, issuance_mode, issuer_party_id, registration_id, series_code, document_number, issued_at, currency, policy_id, template_code, template_revision, content_schema_version, document_content_json, issue_status, submission_status, submission_source, document_file_address, document_digest, void_reason, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.transactionId}, #{row.documentKind}, #{row.documentScopeKey}, #{row.issuanceMode}, #{row.issuerPartyId}, #{row.registrationId}, #{row.seriesCode}, #{row.documentNumber}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.currency}, #{row.policyId}, #{row.templateCode}, #{row.templateRevision}, #{row.contentSchemaVersion}, #{row.documentContentJson}, #{row.issueStatus}, #{row.submissionStatus}, #{row.submissionSource}, #{row.documentFileAddress}, #{row.documentDigest}, #{row.voidReason}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_id, document_kind, document_scope_key, issuance_mode, issuer_party_id, registration_id, series_code, document_number, issued_at, currency, policy_id, template_code, template_revision, content_schema_version, document_content_json, issue_status, submission_status, submission_source, document_file_address, document_digest, void_reason, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_document WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND document_kind = #{documentKind} AND document_scope_key = #{documentScopeKey}

SELECT id, transaction_id, document_kind, document_scope_key, issuance_mode, issuer_party_id, registration_id, series_code, document_number, issued_at, currency, policy_id, template_code, template_revision, content_schema_version, document_content_json, issue_status, submission_status, submission_source, document_file_address, document_digest, void_reason, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_document WHERE transaction_id IN #{v} ORDER BY transaction_id, id
